text:
sarah.ops: Quick wrap from the DR postmortem thread. We have three outstanding remediation threads: multi-region routing flicker (unexpected traffic to eu-west), recurring nightly snapshot failures for shard-09, and missing snapshot validation steps in the restore runbook. Need concrete owners and ETAs by EOD so we can lock the game-day checklist.

jamie.sre: I'll pick up the routing flicker. Initial hunch: LB health-check retries combined with our weighted routing rebalancer causes short-lived traffic swings. I'll instrument per-request region headers and add telemetry to the routing decisions. Target: determine root cause and a short-term mitigation (health-check cooldown) within 72h.

tony.eng: I'll own shard-09 backups. Seeing intermittent timeouts during snapshot stage, suspecting I/O contention with vacuum/compaction. Plan to run an isolated manual snapshot + restore in staging tonight and capture timing + failure traces. ETA: 48h for a test report and a remediation PR.

lina.pm: I'll co-own the restore runbook updates with @tony.eng. We should add a preflight snapshot-tag verification step, size/timestamp checks, and an explicit canary restore flow. I'll draft the runbook snippet and example commands.

oncall-bot: Reminder: DR dry run scheduled next Wednesday 09:00 UTC. Please RSVP with :white_check_mark:.

michael.oncall: Saved the alerts from last week for visibility:
```
ALERT backup_failure shard-09: snapshot exited code 23 after 600s timeout
ALERT route_anomaly: 20% traffic rerouted to eu-west for ~3m window
```

jamie.sre: Small data point: the routing re-route correlates with our cross-region replication batch that runs Thursdays 18:00-19:30 UTC for the last 3 weeks. I'll add tracing and a flag to ignore weight shifts during active replication windows as a canary mitigation.

sarah.ops: Add task: "per-request region tracing and routing-decision logging". Owner: jamie.sre. ETA: 72h.

tony.eng: Backup test plan:
- run manual snapshot of shard-09 in staging
- restore to a fresh instance
- validate record counts + checksums
- observe for interference with vacuum jobs
I'll post logs + timing and open a config PR to adjust retention/quiet windows if needed. ETA: 48h.

lina.pm: Runbook additions I'm proposing:
1) preflight: list snapshots filtered by tag: `aws ec2 describe-snapshots --filters Name=tag:service,Values=redwood`
2) validate latest snapshot timestamp within expected window
3) compute hash of sample objects and compare
4) canary restore to staging before promoting
I'll upload a draft doc and a small shell script snippet for the preflight.

jamie.sre: Short-term LB config change suggestion: increase backend health-check failure threshold 2->5 and add 30s cooldown before weight-shift. Will test in canary.

michael.oncall: I'm creating a Confluence page for tracking and will add these action items + owners: https://confluence.redwood.internal/dr/1725824242. Also sending the calendar invite for the dry run.

sarah.ops: Consolidated action items:
- jamie.sre: instrument routing decisions + propose LB cooldown + add routing mitigation flag (ETA 72h)
- tony.eng: run manual snapshot/restore for shard-09 + post logs + PR (ETA 48h)
- lina.pm + tony.eng: update restore runbook with snapshot tag validation + canary steps (ETA 72h)
- michael.oncall: create tracking Confluence page + schedule dry run invite (ETA 24h)

sarah.ops: We'll reconvene after the canary restore and tracing data. If anyone needs to reassign, reply here. :thumbsup:

jamie.sre: Starting instrumentation now, will post a short log and a tracing dashboard link when ready.

tony.eng: Kicking off the staging snapshot in ~30m, will attach results here.

lina.pm: Drafting runbook changes, will ping for review in the thread.

oncall-bot: Automated follow-up scheduled in 24h to check progress on outstanding tasks.
